flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: The Democrats' chances of winning control of the Senate rose sizably in the Polymarket odds over the last day. The projected seat count moved to 53-47, up from 52-48, which means Democrats gain control, and [[Kansas]] is a newly predicted flip. The Democrat there, Adam Hamilton, gained ground, as did the Democrat in [[Michigan]], Abdul El-Sayed, who also saw a sizable improvement in the market.
summaries.governor: In [[Georgia]], Polymarket odds moved sizably in favor of the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms, and the market sees it as a predicted flip. The Democrat in [[Iowa]], Rob Sand, also gained ground by a moderate amount, and that race is likewise a predicted flip. Meanwhile, the Republican in [[Texas]], Greg Abbott, saw a moderate drop in the market's odds.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the House edged up slightly, and the Democrats remain the favoured party. The biggest single move came in [[NC-11 (Asheville & Hendersonville)]], where the Democrat Jamie Ager gained sharply, with the Republican Jennifer Balkcom the other candidate named in the market. The market treats that seat as a predicted flip.
